Graphite typography, very fine horizontal rules, deliberately asymmetric proportions, no giant magazine headline, no decorative serif headline, no illustration, no gradients, no drop-shadow pile, no equal card grid. Sophistication through small typography, generous but functional line spacing, precise alignment, crisp single borders, controlled negative space. Neutral navigation and actions; restrained amber for pending human decisions and small semantic status accents.
